story.zh: 建安廿五年，魏王操头疾笃，薨于邺城文昌殿，春秋六十有六。谥曰武王，葬高陵。是日邺中玄云四合，漳水为之不流。
story.en: In the 25th year of Jianan, Cao Cao, King of Wei, fell gravely ill with a headache and passed away in Wenchang Hall at Ye at the age of sixty-six. He was posthumously titled King Wu and buried in Gaoling. On that day, dark clouds gathered from all sides over Ye, and the River Zhang ceased to flow.

participate.zh: 【身属曹操势力】、【曹丕、曹植、曹彰为曹操麾下武将】、【许昌、邺、南皮属曹操】
participate.en: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and Cao Zhang are Officers under Cao Cao】, 【Xuchang, Ye, and Nanpi belong to Cao Cao】

defy.zh: 【<身为曹操势力武将>宣布继承人并决定曹魏的未来】
defy.en: 【<As an Officer of Cao Cao's Faction> Announce an heir and decide the future of Cao Wei】

conditions.en: Cao Cao is not the player

force.zh: 主角必须为<曹操>势力武将
force.en: The protagonist must be an Officer of the <Cao Cao> Faction

force.zh: 曹操身为君主并占领<许昌><邺><洛阳><南皮>
force.en: Cao Cao is a Ruler and controls <Xuchang><Ye><Luoyang><Nanpi>

force.zh: 曹丕、曹植、曹彰回归曹操势力
force.en: Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and Cao Zhang return to Cao Cao's Faction.
